notes: TBox expansion, paired with people-replace-0006. Keeps the revision's relation (has_outcome) and new conclusion (a silver medal for winning) and gives it to a made-up competition, the Brenmoor Games, under the real class of sporting competitions, so no old value is pushed out. The derived queries name invented athletes who won an event at the Brenmoor Games, stated in the prompt (inheritance, 2 hops, bridge in the prompt): the inserted rule is their only route to the medal. The near unrelated query asks the real Olympic rule, which must stay gold; a method that learned a bare 'winner gets silver' mapping would leak there. Games and athlete names are invented; the counting step records that they are absent from the corpus. The 'since 1904' qualifier of the revision is dropped because the made-up games have no history to date. Side facts and checks are those of the paired revision.
